text: SEMKIT-090: a refinement by words still depends on the order of the rows when both phrases have as many units. Example: rows «мастер по ремонту стиральных машин», then «ремонт стиральных машин» give other/other (2 units each). Cause: Phrase.before() (core/relate/phrases.py) compares the number of units, then the row. The task asked the reverse order only for «ремонт стиральных и посудомоечных машин» (3 units against 2), which passes.

The help renderer reads a docstring line that starts with 'word:' (for example 'relation: same, ...') as the description of an option and drops the rest of the paragraph from --help. A rule in CODING_STANDARDS.md (never start a wrapped docstring line with 'word:') would help step authors.
